cells.quote: Finally, response instructions had a significant main effect on the ease-of-cheating item (F(1, 362) = 4.53, p = .034, η2 = .01) with the would-do instructions (M = 5.33, SD = 1.79) judged as easier to cheat than the should-do instructions (M = 4.92, SD = 1.86).
